review:
A carnival of monsters on 5x4. xSplit symbols land on reels 1 and 5, as singles or full stacks, and split the symbols in their path for more ways.

Three scatters give three Chimera Spins where a middle-reel scatter becomes a sticky wild; Super Chimera Spins add a super scatter. A paid Coinage mode fills the reels with multiplier coins and specials. Extreme volatility, 20,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
